fest.ceremony.ahManDuanXing: Ah Man and Duan Xing wave from the back of the crowd. The post road is open, and they were the first to make it here.
fest.ceremony.everyoneStandsSayFew: One by one, everyone stands up to say a few words. Wen Heng writes them all down in the town's rebuilding record.
fest.ceremony.heYanPatsNew: He Yan pats the new blades: "Every last slat was picked from the wood you all brought in."
fest.ceremony.lampsComeNobodyHurry: The lamps come on one by one. Nobody is in a hurry to leave, and the talk at the long tables goes on deep into the night.
fest.ceremony.lowRumbleTurningMillstones: A low rumble of turning millstones drifts from the mill. Lin You is the first to cheer, and everyone laughs along.
fest.ceremony.ribbonFallsWindPours: The ribbon falls, and wind pours in through the mountain pass. The blades creak once, then begin to turn, slow and steady.
fest.ceremony.shenZhouTalksAbout: Shen Zhou talks about the spring the river ran clear again; Lu Yao, about the first glint of crystal light seen in the Mines.
fest.ceremony.songNingLinRead: Song Ning has Lin You read an essay aloud, titled "The Place We Fixed Together."
fest.ceremony.uncleClearsHisThroat: Uncle An clears his throat: "This windmill has stood still for twenty years. If it turns today, it's not thanks to any one person."
fest.ceremony.uncleHandsScissorsCut: Uncle An hands you the scissors: "This cut is yours to make."
fest.ceremony.wholeRowLongTables: A whole row of long tables stretches across the Town Square, draped in the tablecloth Granny Shi kept at the bottom of her chest for years.
fest.ceremony.xiaHeBringsDishes: Xia He brings out the dishes you set aside: "{dishes}: today's stars."
fest.derby.caughtFishOverThree: Caught {0} fish over three rounds, {1} cm in total. First place!
fest.derby.caughtFishOverThree2: Caught {0} fish over three rounds, {1} cm in total. You placed #{2}.
fest.derby.fishingAssistWiderGreen: Fishing assist (wider green zone, slower needle)
fest.derby.shenZhouHoldsScoreboard: Shen Zhou holds up the scoreboard: "Three rounds, one minute each. When the bobber dips, wait for the needle to sweep into the green, then reel in. We measure length, not weight, so there's no shame in a little fish."
fest.derby.tooEarlyTooLate: Too early or too late. It slipped away
fest.derby.watchedWholeDerbyBank: You watched the whole derby from the bank and cheered for every angler.
fest.firefly.baiLuHandsStack: Bai Lu hands you a stack of paper lanterns: "Found all three lantern shadows? Then pick one and set it on the water. Make a wish too, if you like."
fest.firefly.lanternDriftedSlowlyDownstr: A {0} lantern drifted slowly downstream, and the fireflies along the bank lit up all the way.
fest.firefly.stringLightsDriftsSlowly: A string of lights drifts slowly down the river.
fest.hearth.beforeMistLiftsRiver: Before the mist lifts, the river is so quiet you can hear the fish blowing bubbles.
fest.hearth.everyoneSeesGood: Everyone sees all the good you do.
fest.hearth.fireCracklesFinishEveryone: The fire crackles. You finish "{0}", and everyone falls quiet for a moment, then smiles and laughs again.
fest.hearth.grannyShiTossesAnother: Granny Shi tosses another log on the fire: "Tonight ain't about gifts, it's about stories. Once you've told yours, write a note to someone you'd like to thank. No need to sign it, just pop it in that cabinet over there."
fest.hearth.haventMetAnyoneTown: You haven't met anyone in town yet. Go say hello to folks first.
fest.hearth.noteReadsNoName: The note reads: "{0}" No name signed. {1} is sure to smile when they open it.
fest.hearth.onceNearlyGotLost: Once I nearly got lost in the Mines. The old lamps on the walls led me out, one after another.
fest.hearth.sluiceGateWoodsBridge: The Sluice Gate, the Woods Bridge… every one of them came together bit by bit, with everyone's help.
fest.hearth.thankLookingYear: Thank you for looking out for me this year.
fest.hearth.toldDroppedAnonymousGreeting: Told "{0}" and dropped an anonymous greeting into the shared cabinet.
fest.hearth.whenFirstGotBarely: When I first got here I could barely hold a hoe. My first radish came out all crooked, but it was the sweetest thing I've ever eaten.

fest.market.linTangHelpsSet: Lin Tang helps you set up your stall: "Put out up to six things. The judges look at variety, quality and whether it's in season. It's only on loan, and you'll get it all back when we pack up."
fest.market.linTangNotLot: Lin Tang: Not a lot, but you can tell it was grown with care.
fest.market.linTangStallFour: Lin Tang: One stall, and all four of the valley's seasons are on show.
fest.market.stallScoredEverythingBeen: Your stall scored {0} {0|point|points} ({1}). Everything has been returned to you.
fest.market.wenHengQualityLike: Wen Heng: Quality like this deserves a place in the Archive.
fest.market.wenHengTookPhoto: Wen Heng: I took a photo of your stall for this year's records.
fest.market.zhouQinBringOwn: Zhou Qin: Bring some of your own eggs and milk next time. It'll liven up the stall.
fest.market.zhouQinBroughtAnimal: Zhou Qin: You brought animal goods too? Everyone at the Ranch is singing your praises.

fest.picnic.madeTogetherXiaHe: Made {0} together. Xia He says she'd love to team up with you again.

fest.picnic.xiaHeSuchLovely: Xia He: Such lovely colors, and nicely balanced too!

fest.snow.tinyFigureStandingDoor: , a tiny figure standing at its door
